sonnet.problem: The statement is unclear and carries more than one claim. "Now that they have eyewitnesses" has no clear antecedent for "they". In stop 2 card 1 "they" means Peter and the others, but here the sentence goes on to "these believers". The verse never says the believers "have eyewitnesses". Peter and the others are the eyewitnesses, so the phrase adds a premise the text doesn't give.
sonnet.rule: Clear English. Every card reads correctly. ... "He," "she" and "they" always point to someone the baker can tell. / A true or false statement tests one claim.
